title: Real Estate and Facilities Management | IBM Maximo
content:
IBM Maximo® Real Estate and Facilities — the evolution of IBM TRIRIGA — is a comprehensive all‑in‑one solution that elevates the efficiency and intelligence of your operations, providing a single source of truth for all real estate and facilities data.

With new AI‑powered lease abstraction, workflow automation and integrated IoT and data analytics, Maximo Real Estate and Facilities empowers your teams to make faster, more informed decisions, optimize resources, strengthen compliance, and unlock deeper operational insights across your portfolio.
